tagline: World leader in cork-based sustainable solutions
hero_kpi_rationale: Differentiating key indicator: Corticeira Amorim sequesters 15 times more CO2 than its operational emissions (2+ million tonnes annually). This positive environmental impact reflects the company's unique business model based on sustainable management of cork oak forests and validates its responsible growth strategy.

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total annual sales of the company.
kpis.description: In 2012, the company exceeded 500 million euros in revenue for the first time despite a difficult economic environment in Europe.
kpis.signal: Exceeds 500 million euros for the first time in 2012.

kpis.name: CO2 Sequestered
kpis.explanation: Quantity of carbon dioxide absorbed annually through the company's activities and associated forest ecosystem management.
kpis.description: Corticeira Amorim's activities support cork oak forests (montado), which sequester over 2 million tonnes of CO2 per year. This sequestration is independently verified according to ISO 14064 standard and exceeds 15 times the group's operational emissions.
kpis.signal: Sequesters 15 times more CO2 than its total emissions.

ai_positioning.summary: There is no mention of artificial intelligence or related technologies in the provided documents. The company does not appear positioned on the AI wave.
evidence: No reference to AI, machine learning, or APIs in the report.
Initiatives mentioned are focused on sustainability, environmental education, and forest management.
Partnerships (e.g. Siemens, BMW) concern material applications of cork, not digital technology.
